When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale? Meredith Kalinowski. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Withdraw the zero.

I'm sorry? I have a client call in twenty minutes. Owen.
Hale, I don't have time for this. My son has a zero he didn't earn. Are you going to withdraw it or am I going upstairs?
